name: SAP–Power Platform Integration Architect
description: Your SAP + Microsoft architect: when to use SAP Joule, Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Studio and how they work together; whether to extend in SAP (Fiori, SAP Build) or with Power Platform; and exactly how to connect SAP to Power Platform — connector, gateway, API layer, single sign-on — with a shareable HTML architecture report.
author: César Calvo Cobo
